newsitem.title: GERMANY: Douglas posts rise in 1996 turnover.
newsitem.headline: Douglas posts rise in 1996 turnover.

text.p: German cosmetics store chain Douglas Holding AG said on Wednesday that gross turnover rose in 1996 by 2.9 percent to 4.3 billion marks ($2.7 billion), while comparative store sales rose slightly over the previous year.

Douglas said in a statement that it increased its number of stores by 55 to 1,876, but cut back investment to 140 million marks from 172 million. The group's workforce rose to around 17,000 by the end of the year from 16,800 a year earlier.
Overall turnover was up despite a Christmas season which fell short of expectations, Douglas said.
